hits.title: EXPIRE - Redis
hits.text: In Redis versions prior to 2.1.3 altering a key with an expire set using a command altering its value had the effect of removing the key entirely. This semantics was needed because of limitations in the replication layer that are now fixed.

hits.title: Best Practices for Using Redis EXPIRE and TTL Commands
hits.text: Nov 4, 2025 · The EXPIRE and TTL (and their millisecond-aware counterparts PEXPIRE and PTTL) commands are fundamental tools for achieving this data expiration control. If you forget expirations on temporary data, Redis can quietly fill memory with stale cache entries, old sessions, and abandoned lock keys.
